memberdef.name: sli_si91x_crypto_hash_compute

simplesect.para: The signature of this function is that of a PSA driver hash_compute entry point. This function behaves as an hash_compute entry point as defined in the PSA driver interface specification for transparent drivers.

parameterdescription.para: The SHA algorithm to compute.
Input data.
Size of given input.
Output buffer for the hash value.
Size of the ciphertext buffer in bytes. This must be appropriate for the selected algorithm
On success, the size of the output in the ciphertext buffer.
Success.
alg is not supported.
ciphertext_size is too small.

briefdescription.para: Set up a multipart hash operation.

simplesect.para: The signature of this function is that of a PSA driver hash_setup entry point as defined in the PSA driver interface specification for transparent drivers.

parameterdescription.para: Operation object to initialise. Must be zero-initialized or previously aborted.
The SHA algorithm to use (PSA_ALG_SHA_1, PSA_ALG_SHA_224, etc.).
Operation set up successfully.
operation is NULL or alg is not a hash algorithm.
alg is not a supported SHA variant.
No SHA algorithm is enabled.

briefdescription.para: Feed input data into an ongoing multipart hash operation.

simplesect.para: The signature of this function is that of a PSA driver hash_update entry point as defined in the PSA driver interface specification for transparent drivers.

parameterdescription.para: Active operation object returned by a successful sli_si91x_crypto_hash_setup.
Buffer containing the input data. May be NULL if input_length is 0.
Size of the input buffer in bytes. Must not exceed UINT16_MAX. A zero-length update is a valid no-op.

briefdescription.para: Finish a multipart hash operation and produce the digest.

simplesect.para: The signature of this function is that of a PSA driver hash_finish entry point as defined in the PSA driver interface specification for transparent drivers.

parameterdescription.para: Active operation object to finalise.
Buffer where the hash value will be written.
Size of the hash buffer in bytes.
On success, the number of bytes written to hash.
Hash produced successfully.

briefdescription.para: Abort a multipart hash operation and release associated resources.

detaileddescription.para:
The signature of this function is that of a PSA driver hash_abort entry point as defined in the PSA driver interface specification for transparent drivers.
This function is idempotent: calling it on a zero-initialized, already-finished, or previously-aborted operation succeeds with no effect. No firmware command is sent because the firmware resets its SHA context automatically on completion or failure.

parameterdescription.para: Operation object to abort. May be in any state, including zero-initialized.
Operation aborted (or was already inactive).
operation is NULL.
No SHA algorithm is enabled.
